headline: Sarvam AI closes $300 million Series B led by HCL Technologies and Bessemer Venture Partners
sum: Sarvam AI, a sovereign-AI platform for Indian languages, closed a $300 million Series B led by HCL Technologies (acquiring 10.46% equity) and Bessemer Venture Partners, with capital directed to agentic AI, coding, cybersecurity capabilities and large-scale compute deployment.
implication: HCL's strategic equity stake signals enterprise demand for sovereign, language-localized AI infrastructure in India; the 10.46% acquisition indicates deep partnership beyond typical institutional venturing and may require CCI review under beneficial ownership thresholds.
detail: Sarvam AI, building a full-stack sovereign AI platform optimized for Indian languages and governance, closed its Series B with HCL Technologies as lead investor acquiring a 10.46% equity stake. Bessemer Venture Partners co-led the round alongside existing backers. The capital will support next-generation model development (agentic AI, coding, cybersecurity), large-scale GPU and compute access, and vertical deployment in Indian governance contexts.
